snippet.title: Manabu Nagayama & Soichi Terada - Low Tension (2014 Version)
snippet.description:
https://www.discogs.com/Manabu-Nagayama-Soichi-Terada-Low-Tension/release/6649427

Utopia Records is the anticipated new label project by Alexander Bradley in collaboration with Soho record store Phonica, set to unearth a diverse range of music, from official re-releases and remastering of obscurities to contemporary and cutting edge club and home listening music. Touching on Jazz, Techno, House, Ambient, Disco and Boogie through to left-field Cosmic, Balearic Soul and Rock. The First release comes in the form of an essential ambient Japanese house track by Legendary producers Manabu Nagayama and Soichi Terada. This highly sought after version of Low Tension originally released on the 'La Ronde' EP on BPM Records Japan in 1991, has been remastered for single release for the first time. Also features a stripped back rework by cult Japanese producer Yukihiro Fukutomi and Bradley himself with an extended deep, dubby and melodic Utopian mix. The mythical deep house works of Japanese producers such as Nagayama and Terada have become online folklore with the latter's production for Nami Shimada entitled 'Sunshower' (featuring Larry Levan mix) a holy grail for house heads. Pressed Loud and Limited with its original beautiful stunning artwork on a full picture sleeve - all the trimmings by Phonica / Vinyl Factory London. We hope you enjoy this timeless record for years to come.

snippet.title: Soichi Terada - I Wanna Be With You (1995)
snippet.description:
Inspired instrumental rework of 1985 boogie classic "I Wanna Be With You" by Armanta. Last heard on Terada's hard-to-find "Far East Recording 2" release. And, the Chinese Coke label is just beyond dope.

https://www.discogs.com/release/1115377-Soichi-Terada-Far-East-Recording-2
